author: Ayeda Okambawa
name: SAM2
description: Generates selection masks for a photo using Meta's Segment Anything 2 model via the sam2-tools helper.
description-extensive: Automatically creates selection masks (outlines around objects) in your photo using Meta's Segment Anything 2 artificial-intelligence model, so you can adjust just part of an image. It needs the matching sam2-tools helper program installed.
